    JOIN Matches m ON m.start_date = pd.debut_date

WITH lara_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.delivery_id,
        d.non_striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.striker_id 
            ORDER BY d.delivery_id 
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) as cumulative_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Brian Lara'
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM lara_runs lr
JOIN Players p ON lr.non_striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE lr.cumulative_runs >= 400
ORDER BY lr.delivery_id
LIMIT 1;

WITH lara_runs AS (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.runs_scored, d.non_striker_id,
           SUM(d.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number) as cumulative_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Brian Lara%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%Lara%'
    ORDER BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.ball_number
),
run_400 AS (
    SELECT match_id, inning, non_striker_id
    FROM lara_runs
    WHERE cumulative_runs >= 400
    ORDER BY match_id, inning, over_number, ball_number
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM run_400 r
JOIN Players p ON r.non_striker_id = p.player_id;

FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.non_striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Players striker ON d.striker_id = striker.player_id
WHERE striker.player_name = 'BC Lara'

    AND d2.inning = d.inning
    AND (d2.over_number < d.over_number OR (d2.over_number = d.over_number AND d2.ball_number <= d.ball_number))

SELECT p.player_name

WITH chases AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.match_winner,
        -- First innings total
        (SELECT SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs) 
         FROM Deliveries d1 
         WHERE d1.match_id = m.match_id AND d1.inning = 1) as first_innings_total,
        -- Second innings batting team
        (SELECT DISTINCT d2.batting_team 
         FROM Deliveries d2 
         WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.inning = 2 
         LIMIT 1) as chasing_team,
        -- Second innings total
        (SELECT SUM(d2.runs_scored + d2.extra_runs) 
         FROM Deliveries d2 
         WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.inning = 2) as second_innings_total
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE m.venue = "Lord's"
)
SELECT 
    chasing_team as team,
    COUNT(*) as successful_chases
FROM chases
WHERE match_winner = chasing_team 
    AND second_innings_total > first_innings_total
GROUP BY chasing_team
ORDER BY successful_chases DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH lords_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id, team1, team2, match_winner
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE venue LIKE '%Lord%' AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
second_innings_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) as total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN lords_matches lm ON d.match_id = lm.match_id
    WHERE d.inning = 2
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
),
successful_chases AS (
    SELECT 
        sit.match_id,
        sit.batting_team as chasing_team,
        sit.total_runs,
        lm.match_winner
    FROM second_innings_totals sit
    JOIN lords_matches lm ON sit.match_id = lm.match_id
    WHERE sit.batting_team = lm.match_winner
)
SELECT chasing_team, total_runs
FROM successful_chases
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH PlayerTestMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        m.match_id,
        m.start_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_id ORDER BY m.start_date, m.match_id) as match_number
    FROM Players p
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON p.player_id = pim.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.match_type_number = 1
),
PlayerInningsRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) as runs_scored
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
),
PlayerCenturies AS (
    SELECT 
        ptm.player_id,
        ptm.player_name,
        ptm.match_id,
        ptm.match_number,
        COUNT(*) as centuries_in_match
    FROM PlayerTestMatches ptm
    JOIN PlayerInningsRuns pir ON ptm.match_id = pir.match_id AND ptm.player_id = pir.striker_id
    WHERE ptm.match_number <= 2 AND pir.runs_scored >= 100
    GROUP BY ptm.player_id, ptm.player_name, ptm.match_id, ptm.match_number
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    SUM(centuries_in_match) as total_centuries_in_first_two_matches
FROM PlayerCenturies
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY total_centuries_in_first_two_matches DESC, player_name;

WITH PlayerFirstTwoTests AS (

),
PlayerCenturies AS (

    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerFirstTwoTests pft ON d.striker_id = pft.player_id AND d.match_id = pft.match_id
    WHERE pft.match_number <= 2
    GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning
    HAVING runs_in_innings >= 100
)

    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100

WITH PlayerFirstTwoTests AS (
    SELECT 
        pim.player_id,

    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.match_type_number = 1

    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.match_winner, p.player_name as bowler_name, 
       pim.team_name as bowler_team, d.inning,
       COUNT(*) as wickets_taken

WITH test_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id, venue
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE match_type_number = 1
),
venue_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.venue,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM test_matches tm
    JOIN Deliveries d ON tm.match_id = d.match_id
    GROUP BY tm.venue
),
venue_centuries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT tm.venue
    FROM test_matches tm
    JOIN Deliveries d ON tm.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY tm.venue, tm.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
    HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT venue
FROM venue_runs
WHERE venue NOT IN (SELECT venue FROM venue_centuries)
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT venue, SUM(runs_scored) as total_runs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.match_type_number = 1
AND venue NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m2.venue
    FROM Deliveries d2
    JOIN Matches m2 ON d2.match_id = m2.match_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) as runs
        FROM Deliveries
        WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
        GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning
        HAVING runs >= 100
    ) centuries ON d2.striker_id = centuries.striker_id 
                 AND d2.match_id = centuries.match_id 
                 AND d2.inning = centuries.inning
    WHERE m2.match_type_number = 1
)
GROUP BY venue
ORDER BY total_runs DESC

    END as opposing_team,
    COUNT(*) as wins
FROM Matches 
WHERE city IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT city 
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE team1 = 'Australia' OR team2 = 'Australia'
) 
AND (team1 = 'Australia' OR team2 = 'Australia')
AND match_winner != 'Australia'
AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY opposing_team
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

            WHEN team1 = match_winner AND team1 != 'Australia' THEN team1
            WHEN team2 = match_winner AND team2 != 'Australia' THEN team2
        END as team_name
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE city IN (SELECT DISTINCT city FROM Matches WHERE team1 = 'Australia' OR team2 = 'Australia')
    AND (team1 = 'Australia' OR team2 = 'Australia')
    AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
    AND match_winner != 'Australia'

GROUP BY team_name
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

    AND match_winner != 'Australia'

WITH team_chases AS (
    SELECT 
        m.team2 as chasing_team,
        m.match_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team2 THEN d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) as team2_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) as team1_score
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.venue = 'Eden Gardens' AND m.city = 'Kolkata'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team2
),
successful_chases AS (
    SELECT 
        chasing_team,
        COUNT(*) as successful_chases
    FROM team_chases tc
    JOIN Matches m ON tc.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE tc.team2_score > tc.team1_score AND m.match_winner = tc.chasing_team
    GROUP BY chasing_team
)
SELECT chasing_team
FROM successful_chases
ORDER BY successful_chases DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH match_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.match_winner,
        d.batting_team,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) as total_runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.venue = 'Eden Gardens' AND m.city = 'Kolkata'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning
),
successful_chases AS (
    SELECT 
        mt1.match_id,
        mt1.batting_team as chasing_team,
        mt1.total_runs as chase_total,
        mt2.total_runs as target_total
    FROM match_totals mt1
    JOIN match_totals mt2 ON mt1.match_id = mt2.match_id
    JOIN Matches m ON mt1.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE mt1.inning = 2 
    AND mt2.inning = 1
    AND mt1.batting_team != mt2.batting_team
    AND mt1.batting_team = m.match_winner
    AND mt1.total_runs > mt2.total_runs
)
SELECT 
    chasing_team,
    MAX(chase_total) as highest_successful_chase
FROM successful_chases
GROUP BY chasing_team
ORDER BY highest_successful_chase DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SELECT DISTINCT city 
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE team1 = 'India' OR team2 = 'India'
)

AND match_winner != 'India'

  AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND match_winner = CASE

WITH away_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        team2 as team,
        COUNT(*) as total_away_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as drawn_matches
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE result_type IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team2
),
draw_percentages AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        total_away_matches,
        drawn_matches,
        CAST(drawn_matches AS FLOAT) / total_away_matches * 100 as draw_percentage
    FROM away_matches
    WHERE total_away_matches > 0
)
SELECT team, draw_percentage
FROM draw_percentages
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team_name,
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(CASE WHEN result_type = 'draw' THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) as draw_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.result_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.team1 != m.venue THEN m.team1
            WHEN m.team2 != m.venue THEN m.team2
        END as team_name
    FROM Matches m
    WHERE team_name IS NOT NULL
) away_matches
GROUP BY team_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team,
    ROUND(100.0 * draw_matches / total_away_matches, 2) as draw_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team,
        COUNT(*) as total_away_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draw_matches
    FROM (
        SELECT team1 as team, result_type, venue
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE team1 != venue
        UNION ALL
        SELECT team2 as team, result_type, venue  
        FROM Matches
        WHERE team2 != venue
    )
    GROUP BY team
    HAVING total_away_matches > 0
)
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team,
    ROUND(CAST(draw_matches AS FLOAT) / total_matches * 100, 2) as draw_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'no result' OR match_winner IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draw_matches,
        COUNT(*) as total_matches
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, team1 as team, match_winner, result_type, venue, city
        FROM Matches
        WHERE venue != city OR city IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, team2 as team, match_winner, result_type, venue, city
        FROM Matches  
        WHERE venue != city OR city IS NULL
    )
    GROUP BY team
    HAVING total_matches > 0
)
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

        COUNT(*) as total_away_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as away_wins
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(start_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2001
    AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team2
),
away_win_percentages AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        total_away_matches,
        away_wins,
        CAST(away_wins AS REAL) / total_away_matches * 100 as away_win_percentage
    FROM away_matches
    WHERE total_away_matches > 0
)
SELECT team
FROM away_win_percentages
ORDER BY away_win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team_name,
    ROUND(CAST(wins AS FLOAT) / total_matches * 100, 2) as win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team_name,
        COUNT(*) as total_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            match_id,
            team1 as team_name,
            match_winner,
            venue,
            city
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            match_id,
            team2 as team_name,
            match_winner,
            venue,
            city
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
    ) all_teams
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT match_id, team1 as home_team FROM Matches
        UNION
        SELECT DISTINCT match_id, team2 as home_team FROM Matches
    ) home_info ON all_teams.match_id = home_info.match_id
    WHERE all_teams.team_name != home_info.home_team
    GROUP BY team_name
    HAVING total_matches > 0
) team_stats
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

SELECT

FROM (

    FROM (

FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

    AND pim.team_name = 'Australia'
    AND d.batting_team = 'Australia'

HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) >= 5
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN d.delivery_id END) > 0
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) as total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id 
                       AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                       THEN d.match_id END) as dismissals,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) as matches_played,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id 
                                 AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                                 THEN d.match_id END) = 0 
        THEN SUM(d.runs_scored) 
        ELSE CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id = d.striker_id 
                                                                     AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                                                                     THEN d.match_id END)
    END as batting_average
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
WHERE m.city LIKE '%India%' 
    AND ((m.team1 = 'India' AND m.team2 = 'Australia') OR (m.team1 = 'Australia' AND m.team2 = 'India'))
    AND pim.team_name = 'India'
    AND d.batting_team = 'India'
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) >= 5
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Deliveries d

WITH home_matches AS (
    SELECT 
        team1 as team,
        CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as win
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
    AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
team_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        COUNT(*) as total_home_matches,
        SUM(win) as home_wins
    FROM home_matches
    GROUP BY team
)
SELECT 
    team,
    ROUND(100.0 * home_wins / total_home_matches, 2) as home_win_percentage
FROM team_stats
WHERE total_home_matches > 0
ORDER BY home_win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team_name,
    ROUND(CAST(wins AS FLOAT) / total_matches * 100, 2) as win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team_name,
        COUNT(*) as total_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, team1 as team_name, match_winner, venue
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, team2 as team_name, match_winner, venue
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
    ) team_matches
    WHERE venue LIKE '%' || team_name || '%' 
       OR venue IN (
           SELECT DISTINCT venue 
           FROM Matches 
           WHERE (team1 = team_name OR team2 = team_name) 
             AND start_date >= '2001-01-01'
           GROUP BY venue, team_name
           HAVING COUNT(*) > COUNT(CASE WHEN team1 = team_name THEN 1 END)
       )
    GROUP BY team_name
    HAVING total_matches >= 10
) team_stats
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team_name,
    ROUND(
        (CAST(home_wins AS FLOAT) / CAST(total_home_matches AS FLOAT)) * 100, 2
    ) as home_win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_winner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as home_wins,
        COUNT(*) as total_home_matches
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            team1 as team_name,
            CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_winner
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            team2 as team_name,
            CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_winner
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
    ) home_matches
    GROUP BY team_name
    HAVING total_home_matches > 0
) team_stats
ORDER BY home_win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    team_name,
    ROUND(CAST(wins AS FLOAT) / total_matches * 100, 2) as win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team_name,
        COUNT(*) as total_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, team1 as team_name, match_winner, venue
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, team2 as team_name, match_winner, venue
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE start_date >= '2001-01-01'
    ) team_matches
    WHERE venue LIKE '%' || team_name || '%' OR venue IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT venue 
        FROM Matches 
        WHERE (team1 = team_name OR team2 = team_name) 
        AND start_date >= '2001-01-01'
        GROUP BY venue, team_name
        HAVING COUNT(*) > (
            SELECT COUNT(*) 
            FROM Matches m2 
            WHERE m2.venue = Matches.venue 
            AND (m2.team1 != team_name AND m2.team2 != team_name)
            AND m2.start_date >= '2001-01-01'
        )
    )
    GROUP BY team_name
    HAVING total_matches > 0
) team_stats
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

    FROM Deliveries 
    WHERE inning = 1
    GROUP BY match_id, batting_team
),
all_out_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        batting_team,
        total_runs
    FROM first_innings_scores 
    WHERE total_runs < 120 AND wickets_lost = 10
)

WHERE m.match_winner = a.batting_team;

SELECT

        (COUNT(CASE WHEN result_type = 'no result' OR result_type IS NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 
        2
    ) as draw_percentage
FROM Matches 
GROUP BY team1 
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN venue LIKE '%' || team1 || '%' OR city LIKE '%' || team1 || '%' THEN team1
        WHEN venue LIKE '%' || team2 || '%' OR city LIKE '%' || team2 || '%' THEN team2
        ELSE team1
    END as home_team,
    COUNT(*) as total_matches,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draw_matches,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as draw_percentage
FROM Matches
GROUP BY home_team
HAVING total_matches > 0
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Matches

    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.inning = 1

    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team

SELECT DISTINCT m.match_id, m.season, m.start_date, m.match_winner, 
       SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) as first_innings_total
FROM Matches m

WHERE m.season LIKE '2010%' OR m.season LIKE '2011%' OR m.season LIKE '2012%' OR 
      m.season LIKE '2013%' OR m.season LIKE '2014%' OR m.season LIKE '2015%' OR 
      m.season LIKE '2016%' OR m.season LIKE '2017%' OR m.season LIKE '2018%' OR 
      m.season LIKE '2019%'
  AND d.inning = 1
  AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY m.match_id, m.season, m.start_date, m.match_winner
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) < 150
  AND m.match_winner = (
    SELECT d2.batting_team 
    FROM Deliveries d2 
    WHERE d2.match_id = m.match_id AND d2.inning = 1

    SELECT 1
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) as total_runs
      FROM Deliveries d
      WHERE d.match_id = m.match_id
        AND d.inning = 1
      GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning
    ) first_innings
    WHERE first_innings.batting_team = m.match_winner
      AND first_innings.total_runs < 150
  );

FROM (
    SELECT 
        team2 as team,
        COUNT(*) as total_away_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draws
    FROM Matches 
    GROUP BY team2
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
)
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as draw_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        team2 as away_team,
        result_type
    FROM Matches
    WHERE result_type IS NOT NULL
) away_matches
GROUP BY away_team
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH team_away_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        team1 as team,
        COUNT(*) as total_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'no result' OR result_type = 'tie' OR match_winner IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draws
    FROM Matches 
    GROUP BY team1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        team2 as team,
        COUNT(*) as total_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result_type = 'no result' OR result_type = 'tie' OR match_winner IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as draws
    FROM Matches 
    GROUP BY team2
),
team_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        team,
        SUM(total_matches) as total_matches,
        SUM(draws) as total_draws
    FROM team_away_stats
    GROUP BY team
    HAVING SUM(total_matches) >= 20
)
SELECT 
    team,
    total_matches,
    total_draws,
    ROUND((total_draws * 100.0 / total_matches), 2) as draw_percentage
FROM team_totals
ORDER BY draw_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT

FROM (

        team2 as away_team,
        result_type
    FROM Matches
    WHERE result_type IS NOT NULL
) away_matches

    SUM(d.runs_scored) as total_runs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.match_id = pim.match_id AND d.striker_id = pim.player_id
WHERE m.start_date > '2015-12-31'
AND pim.team_name != CASE 
    WHEN m.city IS NULL THEN m.team1
    ELSE CASE 
        WHEN m.team1 LIKE '%' || m.city || '%' THEN m.team1
        WHEN m.team2 LIKE '%' || m.city || '%' THEN m.team2
        ELSE m.team1
    END
END
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) as not_outs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.start_date > '2015-12-31'
    AND d.wicket_type IS NULL
    AND d.ball_number = 6
    AND d.over_number = (
        SELECT MAX(over_number) 
        FROM Deliveries d2 
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id 
            AND d2.inning = d.inning 
            AND d2.batting_team = d.batting_team
    )
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY not_outs DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) as ducks
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
AND d.player_out_id = p.player_id
AND m.start_date > '2015-12-31'
AND p.player_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker_id
    FROM Deliveries d2
    JOIN Matches m2 ON d2.match_id = m2.match_id
    WHERE d2.striker_id = p.player_id
    AND d2.runs_scored > 0
    AND m2.start_date > '2015-12-31'
    AND d2.match_id = m.match_id
    AND d2.inning = d.inning
    AND (d2.over_number < d.over_number OR (d2.over_number = d.over_number AND d2.ball_number < d.ball_number))
)
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY ducks DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) as duck_outs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.player_out_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.start_date > '2015-12-31'
    AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
    AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
    AND d.player_out_id IN (
        SELECT striker_id
        FROM Deliveries d2
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id
            AND d2.inning = d.inning
            AND d2.striker_id = d.player_out_id
        GROUP BY d2.striker_id
        HAVING SUM(d2.runs_scored) = 0
    )
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY duck_outs DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) as maiden_overs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.start_date > '2015-12-31'
    AND d.wides = 0 
    AND d.noballs = 0
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.bowler_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 0
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY maiden_overs DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) as maiden_overs
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

WHERE m.start_date > '2015-12-31'
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.bowler_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 0 
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 6
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name

LIMIT 5;
